doubts: Y3: ExORL datasets (RND, APS, PROTO, DIAYN) treated as data variants of one environment, giving 4 domains; counting each domain-dataset pair would give 14. Y8: the downstream tasks are unseen during reward-free pretraining, but the paper does not say hyperparameters were tuned elsewhere than on those tasks. Y12: IQM is computed per domain and paired with a standard deviation, not with rliable's stratified bootstrap. Y7: Kitchen datasets are versioned (-v0) but ExORL datasets are not, so coded no under the strict rule.
